english: Almost to St. Mont Blanc Academy!
Come to think of it, what's that school like?\nI feel like someone said all the students\ncan fight or something.

St. Mont Blanc Academy has lots
of departments, and most of them
are 'Magical' departments with
combat techniques attached.

Cooking, sewing, math, music,
and so on- in ancient times, all
of them were techniques born from
the struggles of living things, but
as the ages grew peaceful and\nthe need for combat faded,\nthey were absorbed into wholesome culture.
Like how the javelin throw went from\na combat technique to a sport?

Exactly. For example, in the
Magical Patissier department,
they focus on making sweets,
while also researching techniques
that apply those cooking
skills to combat.

But since combat techniques
are their roots, it's based on
the philosophy of cherishing
the original techniques and
preserving their original forms.
Hmm, that might not be so different\nfrom I-U's research philosophy…
Almost to St. Mont Blanc Academy!
Come to think of it, what's that school like?\nI feel like I heard all the students\ncan fight or something.
At St. Mont Blanc Academy, starting with\nthe Magical Magician department I'm in,\ncombat techniques are required.
Cooking, sewing, math, music-\nwhen they were invented way back,\nthey were all techniques related to fighting, apparently.
Then peaceful times came,\nthe combat-related parts got shaved off,\nand they became safe, I think?
Like how the javelin throw went from\na combat technique to a sport?
My Magical Magician stuff is a fusion of\nsorcery and stage magic, but from a certain period\nit developed as a combat technique, apparently.
So in that sense, we're carefully protecting our roots\nand keeping them alive today?
Hmm, that might not be so different\nfrom I-U's research philosophy…
Interesting story, but\nthis isn't the time for it!
What's wrong?
Looks like we're being ambushed.\nThey don't want us reaching\nSt. Mont Blanc Academy, I wonder?
Well, our movements were plain to see,\nso it can't be helped.\nCan we force our way through?
Too late to go around now.\nLet's go head-on!
//Battle map: Original Character World\n//The teacher set up this battle, so the placement and spawn timing are nasty.
There are some weird ones.\nDo you know what those are?
Waaah, it's slime-chan!\nThat form… don't you think it's lovely?
…The meaning of 'lovely' in this world\nseems different from what I know…
Ugeeh, it's slime-chan.
'-chan'?
[MERU] always said to put '-chan' on slime,\nso it just slipped out.
They're not uncuttable?\nThen there's no problem!
//Battle start\n//Enemy reinforcements on turn 2 - in nasty spots
The hidden ones came out!?\nCheeky things-they've got intelligence?
This many is nothing to worry about!
//Enemy reinforcements on turn 3 - in nasty spots
More were hiding!?\nWas I wrong to think their intelligence low!
Something's off… this placement…\nIt's like a human planned it.
Everyone, don't think this is the end!\nThere's probably more coming!
//Enemy reinforcements on turn 4 - in nasty spots
They were THERE too!?
They keep popping up exactly\nwhere we don't want them to!?
What is this!? It's practically a trap!
They're closing in like a game of go…!\nWhose doing is this…?
//Event at the start of turn 5: teacher appears
We're being pushed back!!
No way I'm going down here!
No waaay! Could this be choberiba?\nI can't belieeeve it!
Th-that voice!!
That hyper voice!?
(Wait, what's choberiba…?)
Eve is gakkari-nko!!
Teacheeer!!
Yeees, [MERU]☆\nHappy?
Yes-yes!
Teacheeer!!
Yeees, [NOEL]☆\nHappy?
Yay!!
Hey, Tsubasa… that's your lifesaver?
That's right.
Seriously…!?
I mean, in this situation,\nwhat IS that energy!?
At this rate you'd be in remedial combat practice, y'know?\nBut I'll do you a little favor today!
Kyapiin☆
//Several grunts on the map explode (vanish)
Wh-!? What was that…!?\nWhat did she do!? Tsubasa, did you see?
No, I couldn't confirm anything like an attack motion.\nIs it something magical…?
At the very least, all I can say is it's\nsomething different from the magic I know…
One more! Kirakira-riin☆
//Several grunts on the map explode (vanish)
Again!?
I told you!\nThe teacher is super strong.
See? She's suuuper strong, right?
Makes me want to rethink the concept of strength…
Now let's clean up quick!\nKurin kurin kurin kurin♪
(Slightly-no, quite outdated…)
//Battle resumes\n//Event at the start of the next turn\n//Eve spots Jeanne and leaves
Umm, right there! Dacchuuno☆
//The spot where Jeanne is hiding explodes. Jeanne appears
Wh-!?
That's Jeanne…!?
Thought you'd erased your presence completely?\nToo bad-Jeanne-woo, totally exposed!\nJust kidding!
Impossible…
Her speech is past its expiration date,\nbut her ability is inhuman…
Well, clean that up for me, okay.\nByebyee☆
//Eve vanishes.
She vanished!
As restless as ever.
It's an assignment from the teacher!\nPrepare yourselves!
Now that we've found you,\nyou're getting beat!
A miscalculation… what my clan hates most…
//Jeanne retreats after several turns or a set amount of damage
With Eve gone, there's no reason\nto stay here anymore…
She didn't seem to want to fight…
She's totally ready to run!
//Battle ends when all enemies are wiped out\n//Background: Original Character World
Teacheeer! Teacheeer!
Teacheeer! Come out, teacheeer!
She just vanished, remember.\nIf she were coming back,\nshe wouldn't have left!
//Eve suddenly appears behind Aria
That's right! That's right!\nIt's bull-chop sauce!
Hah!?
When did you-!?
//Event art: the master appears - 'wakannai'
Hmm, Eve-chan just doesn't knooow☆
But I'm cute, so forgive me☆
(Irritated)
(She wears a mercilessly risque outfit.\nI pay my respects to her overflowing spirit of service)
(Service… is it?)
(Once I've made her spill everything about the light and the travel,\nI get to punch a hole in her, right…)
//Event art off
Eve, you saved me again. Thank you.
It's fine. Sorry for leaving you to handle it.\nGlad I made it in time.
Teacher, why did you suddenly disappear?
Teacher, why'd you suddenly vanish?
Same as you.\nThe light guided me and I ended up in a different world.
Just as I thought.
I see. I see.
Tsubasa said you're the one using\nthe light and the travel. True?
Hmm, dunnooo☆
Looks like somebody wants a hole punched in them…
Mooou, you're so quick-tempered.\nYou're gonna get wrinkles on your face.
Are you messing with me!!
Calm down!\nWe won't get anywhere at this rate!
Eve, tell us what you know so far.\nWe all need it.
Trueee, well then,\nseeing is believing-I'll show you.
//Fade to black\n//Background: the place where we first met in map 1
This is where we were flung\nto Tsubasa's world.
Isn't this the place where we\nmoved to Tsubasa's world?
Correct!\nSo, have you seen this before?
//A stone (Polyal) appears\n//SE: stone appearance sound
Wah! Something came out!?
It's like the stone from when we left Dokoka Town.
What is this!? Where'd you pull it from!?
This is called a 'Polyal.'\nI named it myself.\nCute, right?
Forget the name, explain what it is!
From what I've looked into,\nthis little guy seems to be what's causing\nthe light-and-travel phenomenon.
This little guy?
It's shy, I guess-\nnormally it hides so nobody\nnotices it.
Can't see it, can't touch it,\nno way to notice it.\nIt'd be the best at hide-and-seek☆
What's the principle? Magic?\nOr…
Dunnooo☆
Then how did you find it!?
Seriously speaking… by accident, maybe.
What's serious about that!
I don't know the cause, but\nthe Polyals seem to be\ngoing out of control.
Out of control?
Yeah. Ever been suddenly lit up and flung away?\nThat seems different from its original function.
Same deal-I just happened to discover\na Polyal that was visible by chance.\nSo it really was an accident.
You say out of control,\nbut what is its true ability?
Polyals have something like a will.\nThey emit faint waves\nthat react to human brainwaves.
So they're alive?
Dunnooo☆
Enough of that!\nTell us how YOU'RE using this thing.
I call a Polyal and ask it.\nThat's all. Easy, right?
Um, so I call a Polyal and,\nfor example… 'I want to go to Akihabara!'\nI just ask like that?
Like a taxi.
That's worked so far.\nBut if Polyals have wills of their own,\nthey might refuse sometimes?
That part I really dunnooo☆
I mostly get it.\nThere are still unknowns, like the rampaging,\nbut the usage seems about right.
So 'you can go where you truly wish'\nwas the right answer.
Right, right!
Haruka, totally correct!!
Getting flung to places you didn't wish for\nfeels pretty dangerous, nyo…
That's the tricky part.
Well, whatever.\nLet's try using it!
Where shall we head?
How about IS Academy?\nCharlotte's still officially missing\non her way to IS Academy, right?
Yeah. If everyone's okay with it,\nI'd at least like to finish my transfer procedures…
Dejiko, you're just gonna say\nyou wanna go home again, right?
I'm not saying it, nyo.
You're scheming something, aren't you?
(I'll let this one slide, nyo.\nFirst I'll make it look like I held back,\nthen next time! Next time's the real gamble, nyo… gufufu)
Then let's go to IS Academy.
You're coming too?
Things'll go smoother with everyone around.\nSo-Polyal, please!
//Light emanates from the stone (Polyal)
I-it's glowing…! Wah!
If it succeeds, it'll be great progress!
//END
